description:
FACTORY INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEER 

 Freeform builds AI-native manufacturing systems that unify software, hardware, and physics to produce industrial-scale parts at the speed of human ideation. By treating manufacturing as a single integrated system, we unlock a new era of innovation where complex hardware is designed, built, and scaled without limits. 

 As a Factory Infrastructure Engineer at Freeform, you will have the unique opportunity to bridge the gap between site infrastructure and next-generation autonomous manufacturing. You will deep dive into the complex mechanical systems that power Skyfall, our proprietary printing platform, ranging from industrial fluid and cooling systems, high-pressure gases, and factory performance monitoring systems leveraging sensors and data acquisition. This work is critical to the ultimate goal of enabling Freeform to deploy and scale its hardware stack globally. You will work alongside an interdisciplinary team of engineers to create custom solutions that ensure Freeform’s physical infrastructure is as advanced as the software driving it. The ideal candidate possesses a "no job too big or small" mentality and is a proactive problem-solver dedicated to accelerating the pace of innovation.   

 3D printing experience is not required to be successful here - we look for leaders who are organized, accountable, collaborative, and motivated to build and scale world-class hardware operations. 

 

 Responsibilities: 

 
 Design and implement custom infrastructure for our next-gen printing system, Skyfall, including state-of-the-art thermal management (chillers), industrial plumbing, and high-flow gas delivery 

 Develop and integrate factory performance monitoring systems, leveraging sensors and data acquisition (DAQ) to ensure real-time visibility into utility health, pressure levels, and flow rates 

 Oversee critical utilities, ensuring power, process water, and industrial gases like nitrogen and argon are supplied to the Skyfall fleet in strict accordance with safety codes 

 Define and implement preventive maintenance for facilities equipment (pumps, compressors, and HVAC) to optimize operational efficiency and minimize system downtime with a pragmatic eye for automation opportunities 

 Secure the availability of specialized fluid system components and high-pressure fittings to ensure that infrastructure build-outs and engineering projects always move at the pace of innovation 

 
   Basic Qualifications: 

 
 Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or aerospace engineering or similar engineering discipline 

 2+ years of facilities engineering, factory engineering, launch/ground systems engineering or similar experience 

 Strong first principles understanding of fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, and heat transfer 

 Hands-on ability to troubleshoot and repair complex mechanical and fluid systems 

 
 Nice to Have: 

 
 Experience with Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) practices, specifically regarding high-pressure gas safety (NFPA 55) and metal powder handling 

 Proficiency in 3D CAD software (SolidWorks, NX, or similar) for designing facility layouts, piping routes, and custom mechanical mounts 

 Experience developing infrastructure for high-volume production or scaling automated manufacturing lines 

 Hands-on experience with industrial automation controls, PLCs, or building management systems (BMS) 

 Background in aerospace ground support or rocket engine test site operations involving cryogenic or high-pressure fluid systems 

 Experience with new facility buildouts, including managing external MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) contractors 

 Knowledge of ITAR, ISO 9001, and/or similar industrial compliance standards 

 Experience with metal additive manufacturing or similar powder-based industrial processes 

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present technical infrastructure plans to cross-functional teams 

 
 Location: 

 
 
 Based in Hawthorne, our vertically integrated facility brings technology development, R&D, and production together under one roof. We operate at the center of LA’s deep tech ecosystem, surrounded by some of the most ambitious hardware innovation happening anywhere in the country.

 

 
 Our fast-paced, cross-functional environment is built on close collaboration, and as such, this role requires full-time onsite presence (five days a week), with very limited exceptions.

 

 
 What We Offer: 

 
 We have an inclusive and diverse culture that values collaboration, learning, and making deliberate data-driven decisions.

 We offer a unique opportunity to be an early and integral member of a rapidly growing company that is scaling a world-changing technology.

 Benefits
 
 Significant stock option packages

 100% employer-paid Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance (premium PPO and HMO options)

 Life insurance

 Traditional and Roth 401(k)

 Relocation assistance provided

 Paid vacation, sick leave, and company holidays

 Generous Paid Parental Leave and extended transition back to work for the birthing parent

 Free daily catered lunch and dinner, and fully stocked kitchenette

 Casual dress, flexible work hours, and regular catered team building events

 


 Compensation  
 
 As a growing company , the salary range is intentionally wide as we determine the most appropriate package for each individual taking into consideration years of experience, educational background, and unique skills and abilities as demonstrated throughout the interview process. Our intent is to offer a salary that is commensurate for the company’s current stage of development and allows the employee to grow and develop within a role.   

 In addition to the significant stock option package, the estimated salary range for this role is $100,000-$140,000 , dependent on the candidate's academic level (Bachelors, Masters, or PhD) and demonstrated out of classroom experience. 

 


 Freeform is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values diversity; employment with Freeform is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.
